name: AI Incident Response & Engineering Operations Automation

parameters.text:
=Investigate the incident below.

Title: {{ $json.title }}
Description: {{ $json.description }}
Service: {{ $json.service }}
Service URL: {{ $json.service_url }}
Severity: {{ $json.severity }}
Category: {{ $json.category }}
Initial probable cause: {{ $json.probable_cause }}
Health check evidence: {{ JSON.stringify($json.health_check) }}

Tool available:
- engineering_runbook: search engineering recovery/runbook knowledge

Requirements:
- Always call engineering_runbook at least once using a short query based on category + main symptom.
- Treat health_check evidence as factual. Never invent a service-health result.
- If health_check.checked is false, clearly say that no valid health endpoint was checked.
- Separate evidence from hypotheses.
- Keep the answer concise and operational.

Return plain text only in this exact format:
Evidence:
Runbook Guidance:
Health Check:
Probable Cause:
Recommended Action:
Risk Level:

Do not use Markdown tables.
Do not use ** formatting.
Do not invent facts.

options.systemMessage: You are a software incident investigator. Use factual tool results when available and clearly separate evidence from hypotheses.

parameters.toolDescription:
Search engineering runbooks for troubleshooting and recovery guidance.

Use this tool for authentication failures, login errors, API downtime, database incidents, deployment failures, performance/latency problems, and security incidents.

Always search using the affected service, incident category, and main symptoms.

parameters.title: =[{{ $('Prepare Incident').first().json.severity.toUpperCase() }}] {{ $('Prepare Incident').first().json.title }}
parameters.body:
={{
[
  '## Incident',
  `**Service:** ${$('Prepare Incident').first().json.service}`,
  `**Severity:** ${$('Prepare Incident').first().json.severity}`,
  `**Category:** ${$('Prepare Incident').first().json.category}`,
  `**Team:** ${$('Prepare Incident').first().json.team}`,
  '',
  '### AI Triage',
  $('Prepare Incident').first().json.ai_summary,
  '',
  '### Probable Cause',
  $('Prepare Incident').first().json.probable_cause,
  '',
  '### Recommended Action',
  $('Prepare Incident').first().json.recommended_action,
  '',
  '### Investigation',
  $('AI Incident Investigator').first().json.output
].join('\n')
}}
